redCandidate.setup: Run the existing public GAIA CLI locally with the proposed explicit live-mode flag and without a task manifest. The command performs no browser, network, client, dataset, or paid operation because it rejects before configuration loading.
redCandidate.expected: The public production-oriented entry point recognizes an explicit execute request, then refuses safely only for a missing or invalid configuration, failed local preflight, or an unavailable approved client. It must not launch a client before those checks.
redCandidate.observed: The existing public CLI exits with code 1 before configuration handling and reports that GAIA A/B evaluation supports only --dry-run until live execution is explicitly authorized.
redCandidate.failureReason: There is no public production CLI or command adapter boundary. The only public entry point deliberately implements offline manifest validation, so it cannot execute the requested operator-gated local A/B path.
